# hosted-entities

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/hosted-entities.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `hosted-entities` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.trustanchor`: generated from its catalogue, hosted-entities.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_AUTHORITY_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `HOSTING`, `OPERATOR_API` (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID` (init-param `authorityEntityId`, then system property `oidf.authority.entity_id`, then env `OIDF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID`) | Unset | This authority's Entity Identifier; hosted agents are <id>/federation/agents/<slug> and resources <id>/federation/resources/<slug>; unset, it hosts nothing | **First request**: Unset: /federation/agents fails on its first request | Any | Yes |
| `adminToken` (init-param) | Unset; a secret, never shown | A development static bearer for one servlet's operator routes - /federation/admin/*, hosted-entity enrolment and revocation, /federation/registered-clients - on that servlet, in place of OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN (operator-auth), which it wins over there and which says what the static bearer does. Production never accepts it | **Per request**: Set in production: refused as the servlet starts, with an ERROR naming it; the operator API is REFUSED with the reason OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN gives, and that servlet's operator routes answer 503 until it is removed. Wrong in development: as OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN | Not in production: any value; refuses `OPERATOR_API` | Yes |
| `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL` (init-param `jdbcUrl`, then system property `oidf.authority.jdbc.url`, then env `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL`) | Unset | A direct database for hosted agents, Trust Mark grants and the key history, for development; wins over the data store | **Doesn't start**: Driver missing: hosting is not configured, and with Trust Mark types or key history on PingFederate does not start. Wrong credentials: first use | Not in production: any value; refuses `FEDERATION`, `HOSTING`, `OPERATOR_API` | Yes |
| `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_USERNAME` (init-param `jdbcUsername`, then system property `oidf.authority.jdbc.username`, then env `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_USERNAME`) | Unset | The user for OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL | **First request**: Wrong: the first use of the store fails | Any | No |
| `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD` (init-param `jdbcPassword`, then system property `oidf.authority.jdbc.password`, then env `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD`); or from the file `jdbcPasswordFile` or `oidf.authority.jdbc.password.file` or `OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD_FILE` names | Unset; a secret, never shown | The password for OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_URL, or read from the file OIDF_AUTHORITY_JDBC_PASSWORD_FILE names | **First request**: Wrong: the first use of the store fails | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_AUTHORITY_DATA_STORE_ID` (init-param `dataStoreId`, then system property `oidf.authority.data_store_id`, then env `OIDF_AUTHORITY_DATA_STORE_ID`) | Unset | A PingFederate JDBC data store whose pool the authority's stores use; with neither this nor a JDBC URL everything is in memory, with a warning, and gone at the next restart | **First request**: An unknown id: the first use of the store fails | Any | Yes |
| `openBaoUrl` (init-param) | Unset | OpenBao's address for hosted agents' signing keys, on this servlet; unset, OIDF_OPENBAO_URL and its fallbacks (hosted-entity-signing) | **Per request**: Wrong: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500 | Any | Yes |
| `openBaoToken` (init-param) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The OpenBao token, on this servlet; unset, OIDF_OPENBAO_TOKEN and its fallbacks | **Per request**: Refused: a hosted agent's configuration answers 500 | Any | Yes |
